our_interpretation: The comparison is with the approximately $100 million GPT-4 training cost stated immediately before the claim.
More expensive means dollar training expenditure, not inference prices, benchmark performance or floating-point operations alone.
The named examples must be evaluated separately. Evidence for one cannot establish the claim about both.
Significantly means clearly above the baseline after allowing for estimation uncertainty; no arbitrary percentage threshold is imposed.
The wording identifies GPT-5 with Orion. Evidence must establish which development project it concerns rather than silently substituting a later product name.
